about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Apam Balik Peanut Pancake Folds
recipes.summary: Thick-and-crisp Malaysian folded pancakes with a soft, bubbly centre, filled with crushed peanuts and sugar.
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda, sugar, egg and water into a smooth, pourable batter.
Heat a non-stick frying pan with a little oil over medium heat until a drop of batter sizzles.
Pour in a thick round of batter and cook for 3 minutes, until bubbles pop across the surface and the base is deep golden.
Smear the top with butter and scatter over the peanuts and brown sugar, until the surface is evenly coated.
Fold the pancake in half and cook for 1 minute until the edges are crisp and the sugar has begun to melt.
Slide out, cut into wedges and serve warm while the edges are still crisp.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg batter until the centre is fully set and no longer wet.
Contains peanuts, gluten, milk and egg.
For a dairy-free version use vegetable oil in place of the butter.

recipes.title: Mee Rebus Sweet Potato Gravy Noodles
recipes.summary: Yellow noodles under a thick, sweet-savoury sweet potato gravy with egg, lime and crisp shallots.
steps: Boil the sweet potato in the water for 15 minutes until completely soft, then blend it smooth with a little of the cooking water.
Blend the shallots, garlic, dried shrimp and chilli paste into a rough paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 6 minutes, until the oil separates and the smell turns toasty.
Pour in the sweet potato purée, soy sauce and sugar and simmer for 10 minutes until the gravy coats the back of a spoon.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes until the yolks are set, then peel and halve.
Blanch the noodles and bean sprouts until just tender, then drain well.
Pile the noodles into bowls, ladle over the gravy and top with egg, fried shallots, sliced chilli and a lime wedge.
notes: Contains dried shrimp, so not vegetarian, gluten, egg and soy.
The gravy thickens as it cools, so loosen with hot water when reheating.
Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are fully set. Reheat leftovers until steaming hot right through.

recipes.title: Bubur Lambuk Spiced Beef Rice Porridge
recipes.summary: The fragrant Ramadan-style Malay porridge of rice, coconut milk and warm spices with tender beef, simmered until silky.
steps: Fry the sliced shallots, garlic, ginger and whole spices in the ghee for 4 minutes until golden and fragrant.
Add the mince and cook for 6 minutes, breaking it up until no pink remains.
Stir in the rice, water and salt and bring to a boil until bubbling.
Simmer gently for 40 minutes, stirring often, until the rice has collapsed into a thick, creamy porridge.
Pour in the coconut milk and cook for 5 minutes until hot and glossy.
Remove the whole spices, then ladle into bowls and top with coriander and fried shallots.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef mince until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C.
Dairy-free if you use oil instead of ghee.
Add more water if the porridge sets too thick.

recipes.title: Chee Cheong Fun with Sweet Sauce and Sesame
recipes.summary: Silky steamed rice-flour rolls in a sweet hoisin-style sauce with chilli and toasted sesame.
steps: Whisk the rice flour, tapioca starch, wheat starch, water and oil into a thin batter, then rest it briefly and stir again.
Set a wide steamer over boiling water and grease a shallow tray well.
Pour a thin layer of batter into the tray, cover and steam for 3 minutes until the sheet is translucent and set.
Lift out the tray, cool for 1 minute until you can handle it, then roll the sheet up with an oiled scraper.
Repeat with the remaining batter, greasing the tray each time, until all the rolls are made.
Whisk the hoisin, soy, sesame oil, peanut butter and chilli sauce with 2 tablespoons hot water until smooth.
Cut the rolls into pieces, drizzle with the sauce and finish with sesame and fried shallots.
notes: Contains peanuts, sesame, soy and gluten.
Dairy-free and vegan.
The rolls are best eaten the day they are steamed.

recipes.title: Bak Chor Mee Minced Pork Noodles
recipes.summary: Springy noodles tossed in black vinegar and chilli with minced pork, mushrooms and crisp shallots.
steps: Soak the mushrooms in hot water for 20 minutes until soft, then slice them.
Fry the garlic in the oil for 1 minute, add the pork and mushrooms and stir-fry for 6 minutes until the pork is cooked through with no pink.
Season the pork with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the sugar, then keep it warm.
Whisk the vinegar, remaining soy, sesame oil and chilli sauce in a large bowl.
Heat the stock until simmering and cook the noodles for 3 minutes until just tender with a slight bite.
Lift the noodles into the sauce bowl, toss well, then top with the pork, spring onion and fried shallots.
Serve with a small bowl of the hot stock on the side.
notes: Food safety: cook pork mince until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Lontong Sayur Rice Cake Vegetable Curry
recipes.summary: Compressed rice cakes in a mild coconut vegetable curry with tofu and egg, a Malay and Singaporean morning staple.
steps: Cook the rice in 600ml water for 18 minutes until very soft and sticky, then press into a tray and cool until firm.
Blend the shallots, garlic, lemongrass, turmeric and chilli paste smooth.
Fry the paste in the oil for 6 minutes until the oil separates and it smells toasty.
Add the stock, coconut milk, carrot and beans and simmer for 10 minutes until the carrot is tender.
Add the cabbage and tofu and simmer for 5 minutes until the cabbage is soft.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes until the yolks are set, then peel and halve.
Cut the rice cake into cubes, ladle over the curry and top with egg and fried shallots.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are fully set.
Contains soy and egg.
Dairy-free; leave out the eggs for a vegan version.

recipes.title: Mee Siam Spicy Tamarind Vermicelli
recipes.summary: Thin rice vermicelli in a hot, sweet and sour tamarind gravy with tofu, egg and chives.
steps: Soak the dried chillies in hot water for 15 minutes until soft, then blend with the shallots, garlic and soybean paste into a paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 7 minutes until darkened and the oil separates.
Add the water, tamarind and sugar and simmer for 12 minutes until the gravy tastes sour, sweet and spicy.
Soak the vermicelli in hot water until tender, then drain.
Pan-fry the tofu cubes for 5 minutes until golden on all sides.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes until the yolks are set, then peel and halve.
Pile the vermicelli in bowls, ladle over the gravy and top with tofu, egg, bean sprouts, chives and lime.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are fully set.
Contains soy, gluten and egg.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Singapore Egg Prata with Fish Curry Gravy
recipes.summary: Flaky pan-fried flatbread folded around a spiced egg and onion filling, served with a thin turmeric fish curry gravy.
steps: Knead the flour, 1 egg, water, 1 tablespoon ghee and salt into a soft dough and rest it in oiled balls.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, add the curry powder and turmeric and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk, 200ml water and tomato and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the fish and simmer for 6 minutes until opaque and flaking, then keep warm.
Stretch a dough ball paper-thin on an oiled bench, crack an egg on top and fold the edges into a square.
Fry in ghee for 3 minutes per side, until the egg is set and the dough is crisp and golden.
Crumple lightly to open the layers and serve with the fish gravy.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking and the egg until fully set.
Dairy-free if you use oil instead of ghee.
Rest the dough for at least an hour to make it stretch easily.

recipes.title: Nasi Dagang Terengganu Coconut Rice with Tuna Curry
recipes.summary: East-coast Malay coconut rice with glutinous rice and fenugreek, served with a thick tuna and tamarind curry.
steps: Soak the rice and glutinous rice together for 30 minutes, then drain.
Steam the rice with the fenugreek, coconut milk, water and salt for 30 minutes until the grains are tender and sticky.
Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger, chilli paste and lemongrass smooth.
Fry the paste in the oil for 6 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the coconut cream and tamarind and simmer for 8 minutes until thick and glossy.
Fold in the tuna and heat for 3 minutes until piping hot.
Serve the rice with the curry and sliced cucumber.
notes: Food safety: heat canned fish until piping hot, above 75°C.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Singapore Ginger Chicken Rice Porridge
recipes.summary: Silky rice porridge in rich poaching broth with shredded ginger chicken, spring onion and sesame oil.
steps: Simmer the chicken with half the ginger and the spring onion whites in the water for 18 minutes, until it reaches 75°C and the juices run clear.
Lift out the chicken, cool slightly, then shred it.
Add the rice and salt to the broth and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Season with the white pepper and soy sauce.
Julienne the remaining ginger.
Ladle the porridge into bowls and top with chicken, ginger, spring onion greens, sesame oil, fried shallots and chilli.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken until it reaches 75°C at the thickest part and the juices run clear.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Besan Egg-White Muffin Frittatas
recipes.summary: Dairy-free high-protein mini frittatas bound with egg whites and chickpea flour, packed with spinach and capsicum.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and oil a 12-hole muffin tin well.
Wilt the spinach in the oil for 2 minutes until just collapsed, then squeeze out the excess water and chop.
Whisk the egg whites, eggs, chickpea flour, paprika and salt until smooth with no lumps.
Fold in the spinach, diced capsicum, spring onion and parsley.
Divide among the holes and bake for 18 minutes until puffed, set in the centre and golden.
Cool in the tin for 3 minutes, then ease out with a knife.
notes: Food safety: bake until the egg is fully set with no liquid in the centre, about 75°C.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.
They keep for 3 days in the fridge and reheat well.

recipes.title: Turkey and Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash
recipes.summary: A one-pan, dairy-free, high-protein hash with turkey mince, sweet potato, kale and fried eggs.
steps: Dice the sweet potato small and fry in the oil for 10 minutes, turning, until golden and tender.
Add the onion and capsicum and cook for 4 minutes until soft.
Push to one side, add the turkey and spices and cook for 6 minutes, breaking up, until no pink remains.
Stir in the kale and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Make four wells and crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter with parsley and serve from the pan.
notes: Food safety: cook turkey mince until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C, and eggs until the whites are set.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.
Cook the yolks through for anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Oat and Egg Protein Pancakes
recipes.summary: Dairy-free, flour-free pancakes blended from oats, eggs and soy milk, higher in protein than usual.
steps: Blend the oats, eggs, soy milk, baking powder, vanilla, maple syrup and salt until smooth, then rest the batter.
Heat a non-stick pan with a little oil over medium heat until hot.
Pour in small rounds and cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Stack and top with warmed peanut butter and thinly sliced apple.
notes: Food safety: cook the pancakes until the centre is fully set, not wet.
Dairy-free.
Use certified gluten-free oats for a gluten-free version.

recipes.title: Black Bean Breakfast Bowl with Lime Avocado
recipes.summary: A dairy-free, high-protein bowl of spiced black beans, rice and crisp tortilla with a lime avocado.
steps: Fry the garlic in the oil for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the beans, cumin, paprika and 3 tablespoons water.
Simmer for 6 minutes, mashing a few beans, until thick and saucy.
Toast the tortillas until crisp and break into shards.
Fry the eggs for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Mash the avocado with the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt.
Spoon the rice and beans into bowls and top with the avocado, tomato, egg, tortilla shards and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set and the yolks to your preference, fully for anyone vulnerable.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Salade Lyonnaise with Poached Egg and Bacon
recipes.summary: Bitter frisee, hot bacon, garlic croutons and a poached egg in a warm mustard vinaigrette.
steps: Rub the bread with 1 garlic clove, cube it and toast in the oil for 6 minutes until golden and crisp.
Fry the bacon in its own fat for 7 minutes until crisp and the fat has rendered.
Add the minced shallot and remaining garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute until soft.
Stir in the red wine vinegar and mustard, scraping the pan, until the dressing is warm and glossy.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks runny.
Toss the endive, croutons and warm dressing together.
Top each plate with a poached egg and parsley.
notes: Food safety: this keeps a runny yolk, so use very fresh eggs and avoid it for anyone vulnerable. Cook the bacon until crisp.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Salade Nicoise with Seared Tuna
recipes.summary: Composed Provencal salad of seared tuna, soft eggs, new potatoes, green beans, olives and anchovy mustard dressing.
steps: Simmer the potatoes for 15 minutes until a knife slides in easily, then halve while warm.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks soft, then cool and peel.
Blanch the beans for 3 minutes until just tender and bright green, then refresh in cold water.
Mash the anchovies and garlic into the mustard and vinegar, then whisk in the oil.
Sear the tuna in a hot oiled pan for 90 seconds per side until the outside is golden but the centre is still pink.
Toss the potatoes and beans with half the dressing.
Arrange on a platter with the tomatoes, olives, capers, halved eggs and sliced tuna and drizzle with the rest of the dressing.
notes: Food safety: seared tuna stays rare in the middle, so use very fresh fish and cook through for anyone pregnant or vulnerable. Cook the eggs until the whites are fully set, and cook the tuna through to 63°C until opaque and flaking for anyone vulnerable.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Caesar Salad with Anchovy Garlic Dressing and Sourdough Crumb
recipes.summary: A cheese-free take on Caesar: crisp cos, a coddled-style egg yolk dressing with anchovy, and garlic sourdough crumb.

items: 3 tbsp olive oil for the crumb

steps: Blitz the bread to coarse crumbs and fry in 3 tablespoons oil with 1 garlic clove for 6 minutes until deep golden and crunchy.
Mash the anchovies and remaining garlic to a paste.
Whisk the anchovy paste with the yolk, lemon juice, mustard and Worcestershire sauce until smooth.
Drizzle in the oil slowly, whisking constantly, until thick and creamy like mayonnaise.
Season with the pepper and add a splash of water if too thick.
Tear the cos into large leaves, toss with the dressing and top with the crumb.
notes: Food safety: the dressing uses a raw egg yolk, so use very fresh eggs and avoid it for anyone pregnant, elderly or vulnerable.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Warm Puy Lentil Salad with Roasted Beetroot and Mustard Dressing
recipes.summary: A hearty French-style salad of warm green lentils, roasted beetroot, walnuts and rocket in a grain-mustard dressing.
steps: Roast the whole beetroot wrapped in foil at 200°C for 45 minutes until a knife slides in easily, then peel and cut into wedges.
Simmer the lentils with the bay leaf and garlic for 22 minutes until tender with a slight bite.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar, oil and honey into a dressing.
Drain the lentils and toss with the dressing and thinly sliced onion while still warm.
Toast the walnuts for 4 minutes until fragrant.
Fold in the beetroot, rocket, walnuts and parsley just before serving.
notes: Vegan if you swap the honey for maple syrup.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.
Warm lentils absorb the dressing best.

recipes.title: Seua Rong Hai Grilled Sirloin Salad
recipes.summary: Grilled sirloin sliced thin in a hot, sour lime and chilli dressing with herbs and toasted rice.
steps: Season the beef with the soy and cook on a very hot grill for 3 minutes per side for medium-rare, until browned outside and 55°C at the centre.
Rest for 8 minutes, then slice thinly across the grain.
Stir the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, rice powder and chilli flakes until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the beef with the sauce, sliced shallots and herbs.
Serve on lettuce leaves with sliced cucumber.
notes: Food safety: whole cuts of beef are safe seared on the outside, but cook to at least 63°C if serving anyone pregnant or vulnerable.
Dairy-free and gluten-free if you use tamari.

recipes.title: Yam Woon Sen Glass Noodle Salad
recipes.summary: Slippery mung bean noodles with prawns, pork mince, peanuts and a fierce lime, chilli and fish sauce dressing.
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water for 6 minutes until tender and clear, then drain and cut.
Poach the pork mince in simmering water for 3 minutes until no pink remains, then lift out.
Poach the prawns for 2 minutes until pink and curled, then drain.
Crush the garlic and chillies, then stir with the fish sauce, lime juice and sugar until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the noodles, pork and prawns with the dressing, shallots, celery, tomato and spring onion.
Top with peanuts and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until pink and opaque and pork mince until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C.
Dairy-free.
Contains peanuts, shellfish and fish.

recipes.title: Kenyan Pilipili ya Nyanya Tomato Chilli Relish
recipes.summary: A fiery East African chilli and tomato relish with garlic and lemon, for grilled meat and chips.
steps: Heat the oil and fry the garlic for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped tomato and chillies and cook for 6 minutes until the tomato has collapsed.
Cool slightly, then blend with the lemon juice, salt, sugar and water until smooth.
Return to the pan and simmer for 3 minutes until thickened.
Cool and store in a clean jar.
notes: Hot: wear gloves when handling the chillies.
Vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free.
Keeps for 2 weeks in the fridge.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Awaze Berbere-Style Chilli Paste
recipes.summary: A thick red chilli and spice paste for dipping injera, brushing on meat or stirring into stews.
steps: Toast the paprika, chilli flakes, cumin, ginger, cardamom and cloves in a dry pan for 2 minutes until fragrant and a shade darker.
Heat the oil and fry the crushed garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the toasted spices and salt, then add the wine.
Simmer for 6 minutes, stirring, until thick like a paste and the raw wine smell has gone.
Cool and store in a jar topped with a thin layer of oil.
notes: Vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free.
Keeps for 3 weeks in the fridge under oil.
Use stock instead of the wine if you prefer to avoid alcohol.

recipes.title: Niter Kibbeh Ethiopian Spiced Clarified Butter
recipes.summary: Gently infused clarified butter with ginger, garlic, cardamom and fenugreek, the base of countless Ethiopian stews.
steps: Melt the butter over low heat and skim off any foam as it rises.
Add the onion, garlic, ginger and all the spices.
Simmer very gently for 35 minutes until the milk solids sink and turn golden, the liquid is clear and the kitchen smells rich.
Remove from the heat and let it stand for 10 minutes.
Strain through muslin into a clean jar, discarding the solids.
Cool completely, then cover and store in the fridge for up to two months.
notes: Vegetarian, gluten-free.
Keeps for 2 months in the fridge.
Use 1 teaspoon to finish lentils, eggs or greens.

recipes.title: Kenyan Coconut Tomato Fish Sauce
recipes.summary: A coastal sauce of tomato, coconut cream, turmeric and tamarind, spooned over grilled fish or rice.
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, chilli and spices and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the chopped tomato and cook for 8 minutes until broken down into a thick sauce.
Add the tamarind, coconut cream and salt and simmer gently for 5 minutes until glossy.
Finish with the chopped coriander and taste for salt, lemon and heat.
notes: Vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free.
Serve over grilled white fish or with chapati.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Macadamia and Coriander Pesto
recipes.summary: A cheese-free island pesto of macadamias, coriander, ginger and lime for fish, noodles and grilled vegetables.
steps: Toast the macadamias in a dry pan for 4 minutes, until lightly golden and fragrant, then cool.
Blitz the nuts, garlic and ginger to a coarse crumb.
Add the coriander, basil, lime juice, salt and chilli and pulse until finely chopped.
Stream in the oil with the motor running until the pesto is thick and spoonable.
Taste and adjust the lime and salt, then store under a thin layer of oil.
notes: Contains tree nuts.
Vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free.
Keeps for 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Tahitian Coconut Lime Sauce for Raw Fish
recipes.summary: The creamy citrus coconut dressing used for poisson cru, good on raw fish, steamed vegetables and boiled taro.
steps: Squeeze the limes and whisk the juice with the coconut cream and salt until smooth.
Grate the cucumber and carrot finely and squeeze out the liquid.
Fold the vegetables, onion and spring onion into the sauce.
Season with the chilli flakes.
Chill for 15 minutes and serve cold.
notes: Serve over very fresh sashimi-grade fish only. Fish served raw is not suitable for anyone pregnant or vulnerable.
Vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Huli Huli Pineapple Glaze
recipes.summary: A sticky ginger, soy and pineapple glaze for grilled chicken, tofu or vegetables.
steps: Simmer the pineapple juice, soy, sugar, garlic and ginger for 12 minutes until reduced by a third.
Stir in the tomato sauce and vinegar and simmer for 3 minutes until syrupy and coating the back of a spoon.
Remove from the heat and add the sesame oil.
Brush onto food during the last few minutes of grilling.
notes: Vegan, dairy-free.
Keeps for 2 weeks in the fridge.
Do not reuse any glaze that has touched raw meat; boil it first.

recipes.title: Fijian Lolo Coconut Cream Sauce
recipes.summary: A silky, lightly spiced coconut sauce spooned over steamed cassava, taro or fish.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until translucent.
Add the garlic, ginger, chilli and turmeric and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut cream and salt.
Simmer gently for 6 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened.
Finish with the lime juice.
notes: Vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free.
Do not boil hard or the cream may split.

recipes.title: Samoan Oka Coconut Lime Marinade
recipes.summary: The bright dressing for Samoan oka: coconut cream, lime and onion, spooned over cured fish or cucumber salad.
steps: Dice the onion, tomato and cucumber finely.
Mix the lime juice, coconut cream and salt until smooth.
Fold in the vegetables and chilli.
Chill for 20 minutes and serve cold.
notes: Vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free.
Use fresh limes only for the best flavour.
